title: Monotonicity conjecture for induced saturation in the hypergrid
statement: Let $P$ be a poset, and consider the induced saturation function $\mathrm{sat}^{\star}([t]^n,P)$ whenever it is defined. **Monotonicity conjecture.** The function $(n,t)\mapsto\mathrm{sat}^{\star}([t]^n,P)$ is monotone non-decreasing in both $n$ and $t$ over its domain. The supplied text gives no resolution of this natural monotonicity claim.
source_name: R. Altar Ciceksiz, Victor Falgas-Ravry, Sabrina Lato and Maryam Sharifzadeh, “Induced poset saturation in the hypergrid”, arXiv:2604.12641 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12641

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of April 2026). “This was recently proved independently by Bastide, Hodor, La and Trotter and by Ivan, Fl\'idr and Jaffe .”
